name: @meonode/compiler-repo
description: Repo-root tooling scripts for @meonode/compiler (codegen, drift checks). Not published — see npm/package.json for the published package.

scripts.codegen: bun run scripts/codegen-css-set.ts && bun run scripts/codegen-factories.ts
scripts.check:drift: bun run scripts/codegen-css-set.ts && bun run scripts/codegen-factories.ts && git diff --exit-code crates/meonode-swc-plugin/src/css_props.rs crates/meonode-swc-plugin/src/factories.rs
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --release -p meonode-swc-plugin --target wasm32-wasip1 && cp target/wasm32-wasip1/release/meonode_swc_plugin.wasm npm/meonode_swc_plugin.wasm
